[SWS_PER_00458]
d
If
creationTime
,
modificationTime
, or
accessTime
are
not available, they shall be set to
0
.
c
(RS_PER_00004)
As an example, the
accessTime
is not available for a read-only
File Storage
, and
would therefore be reported as midnight 1970-01-01.
